data.headline: BATL regains compliance with NYSE American listing standards

claims.text: On September 16, 2026, Battalion Oil received notice that it was back in compliance with all NYSE American continued listing standards.

citation.quote: On September 16, 2026, Battalion Oil Corporation (the “Company”) received a letter from NYSE American LLC (“NYSE American” or the “Exchange”) notifying the Company that it is back in compliance with all of the continued listing standards

claims.text: The earlier listing issue involved Sections 1003(a)(i) and 1003(a)(ii) of the NYSE American Company Guide.

citation.quote: Specifically, the letter stated that we are not in compliance with the continued listing standards set forth in Sections 1003(a)(i) and 1003(a)(ii) of the NYSE American Company Guide (the “Company Guide”).

claims.text: NYSE American returned Battalion Oil to normal continued listing monitoring and will remove it from the noncompliant issuers list.

citation.quote: NYSE American advised the Company that it has returned the Company to its normal continued listing monitoring procedures and will remove the Company from the Exchange's list of noncompliant issuers.

claims.text: The earlier notice did not affect Battalion Oil’s ongoing business operations or its SEC reporting requirements.

citation.quote: The notice does not affect our ongoing business operations or our reporting requirements with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
